purpose: Read the AUTHORITATIVE per-card live wiring from web_tool/src/strategy_registry.ts CARD_LAYERS, and correct two errors in my own step-74/75 scoping notes before any measurement is made.
why_this_matters_now: The whole S435 case rests on the claim that the coverage union shrank. If I under-count the CURRENT union, I inflate the apparent novelty of SoS-H1 in my own favour. So the union must be read from the shipped registry, per card, rather than from a flat list of S-numbers scraped out of the bundle.

correction_1_missing_layer.my_step74_claim: The live portfolio is six layers: S312, S344, S355, S356, S431, S432.
correction_1_missing_layer.reality: S382 (Williams %R momentum on XAUUSD-H4, ACCEPT 79.2, n=869) is ALSO live and I omitted it. It appeared in my own bundle scan at step 74 and I dropped it when writing the summary list.
correction_1_missing_layer.impact_direction: AGAINST my case, though only mildly: S382 is on H4, a different card from my H1 candidate, but its trading DAYS still enter a day-level coverage union and n=869 makes it the single broadest surviving layer by trade count.
correction_1_missing_layer.why_recorded: The omission ran in the direction that flatters my hypothesis, and per the step-69 principle an error favouring my own conclusion is more obligatory to record than one opposing it.

correction_2_h1_is_not_empty.implicit_assumption_i_was_carrying: That SoS-H1's card was relatively uncontested because SoS-M15 had been retired.
correction_2_h1_is_not_empty.reality: XAUUSD-H1 carries THREE live layers simultaneously: S356 Brooks trend-resumption, S431 LPSB structure gate, and S312 mid-month drift at 395/395/24.
correction_2_h1_is_not_empty.sharpest_point: S356 is Brooks trend-resumption (chapter 25) and my candidate is Brooks signs-of-strength (chapter 19). Both are Al Brooks bullish-continuation constructs on the SAME card. That is the single most likely source of genuine overlap in this entire exercise, and it did not exist in the S205-era union at all.
correction_2_h1_is_not_empty.consequence: My pre-registered 40-70% coverage forecast may well be too LOW. I am NOT revising it - a forecast revised after seeing the reason it might be wrong is not a forecast. It stands and will be scored as written.

measurement_plan_locked.unit: Day-level coverage, matching S205's method exactly, so the new number is comparable to the historic 98%.
measurement_plan_locked.union_members: All gold LONG-capable live layers. S344 is SHORT-only and is therefore reported SEPARATELY rather than folded in, since a SHORT layer cannot double-count a LONG layer's directional exposure - but its days are also reported so the choice is visible rather than hidden.
